name: Goat, Dire (Mountain Goat)
body:
DIRE GOAT (MOUNTAIN GOAT)
CR 2

XP 600
N Medium animal
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 10, flat-footed 14 (+4 natural)
hp 19 (3d8+6)
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee gore +5 (1d6+3)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 11, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 9
Base Atk +2; CMB +5; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Nimble Moves, Skill Focus (Climb)
Skills Acrobatics +4, Climb +14, Survival +4 (+8 to find food); Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Survival to find food

ECOLOGY

Environment mountains and hills

Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3-8)

Treasure none

ABOUT

This wooly beast is as big as a human and has a wicked glint in its eyes. Mountain goats live on rough terrain and are unparalleled climbers, often able to ascend near-vertical rock walls. They tend to have a very bad temper, but once tamed, they obey their herders without rebelling.
